tasks.DownloadProgress: Calculate the time taken for downloading 40% of the file at a rate of 2 GB/minute.
tasks.RedownloadFromBeginning: Calculate the time needed to redownload the entire file after the restart, considering potential changes in download rate.
tasks.RestartDueToWindowsUpdate: Account for the 20-minute restart due to Windows update installation.
tasks.TotalDownloadTime: Sum up all the times calculated in previous tasks to get the total download time.
